question: What universal range should be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: The meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation is that specified entity.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate on that object in every place as pervading all realms from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in every place, one should contemplate it as extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
